description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) deterministic EVM bytecode inspector that extracts 4-byte function selectors and flags privileged backdoors (transferOwnership, upgradeTo, mint, selfdestruct). Queries live RPC for chain_id (8453 Base, 84532 Base Sepolia, 42161 Arbitrum) unless bytecode_override (0x hex) is supplied for offline analysis; falls back to empty bytecode on RPC error. Returns JSON with is_contract, bytecode_size_bytes, selectors_found, high_risk_selectors, risk_level (HIGH, LOW, EOA), and recommendation.

bytecode_override.description: Optional raw contract runtime bytecode hex string (0x...) for offline analysis without RPC calls

chain_id.description: EVM Chain ID (8453 for Base Mainnet, 84532 for Base Sepolia, 42161 for Arbitrum One)

target_address.description: Hex EVM address of smart contract to inspect (e.g. '0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006')

name: scan_contract_selectors
